long_biography.plain_text:
The Juffali Training Centre reflected Ahmed bin Abdullah Al Juffali's belief that education could strengthen Saudi industry. Established in 1977, it gave young Saudis technical instruction in mechanical, electrical and related trades, with routes into work across the group's factories and workshops. He was also among the founders of King Abdulaziz University.

His philanthropy extended to people with intellectual disabilities. After years of personal giving, he established the Ahmed Al-Juffali Foundation to support the Help Centre's medical, educational and social programmes. He also backed his wife Suad's work in health, education and vocational training through the Jeddah Women's Welfare Society. The foundation continues to promote inclusion, independent living and legal rights.
long_biography.html:
The Juffali Training Centre reflected Ahmed bin Abdullah Al Juffali's belief that education could strengthen Saudi industry. Established in 1977, it gave young Saudis technical instruction in mechanical, electrical and related trades, with routes into work across the group's factories and workshops. He was also among the founders of King Abdulaziz University.

His philanthropy extended to people with intellectual disabilities. After years of personal giving, he established the Ahmed Al-Juffali Foundation to support the Help Centre's medical, educational and social programmes. He also backed his wife Suad's work in health, education and vocational training through the Jeddah Women's Welfare Society. The foundation continues to promote inclusion, independent living and legal rights.
